minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, May 15, 2019
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee Was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, May 15, 2019.
  Members present: Bette Donovan, Chick Campo, Lorraine Missick, Scott Snider,
  and Terry Kistler
  Members absent: George Borst
  Staff Present: Bill Aguirre, Staff Laison, Brandon Granillo, Recreation Coordinator
  and Yvonne Duran, Recreation Coordinator
  Guests Present: Liz Kirk, La Verne resident
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, April17,
  2019 meeting. Motion carried.
2. Guest Speaker: Frank Corral, Nutrition Site Manager
  Frank informed us of the YWCA “Bring a Friend to Lunch” program and are offering
  a free lunch on Friday, May 17th. They are planning to hold this more often in hopes
  of bringing more people into the lunch program. They had 55-60 people on Friday.

  Unfinished Business

3. Nutrition Program: Averaged 33 meals served for the month of April.

4. Bingo Report: No report for April.

5. Meals on Wheels: No report available.

6. Account Balance: To date, account balance is $6,322.52.

7. Fee Schedule for Use of the Facilities: Bingo has not paid for April

8. CSS: No report for April.

9. Mt. SAC Classes: New computer classes are coming soon. Also, new drawing
  classes will be starting. Inclusion will also be taking computer classes. Adding a
  quilting class and classes for mobile phones, iPads, etc.…Decorative Art evening
  classes will also be added.
   New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Sunday, May 19th – Senior Dinner Dance Extravaganza, 5:00-8:00 PM (90 people)
  Monday, May 20th – Military Council Meeting and Reception, 6:30 PM
  Monday, May 27th – Center and City Hall closed in observance of Memorial Day –
  Memorial Day Ceremony at Veterans Hall, 11:00 AM
  Monday, June 17th – Special City Sponsored Lunch (Father’s Day theme) 11:30 AM

11. Facilities Report: A/C work in new fiscal year at Veteran’s Hall. Also, some roof
  repairs. Will be checking for leaks in the kitchen and stage areas. Drinking fountain
  will become a water bottle station. Restrooms at the VA Hall will be updated and a
  door will be moved.

12. Public Comments: Chic asked about the older Americans Award.

  Brandon announced there will be a Line Dance event on August 20 th.

  Liz Kirk complimented the front office staff.

  Bill informed us that next week, Tri-City will have an office at the Community Center
  where they will be available on Mondays from 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM and Fridays from
  8:00 AM – 4:00 PM.

  Scott said the gift shop at Hillcrest is open from 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM.

  Lorraine gave an update on the volunteers at Pomona Valley Hospital. All will have a
  blood test to find out if they need the measles vaccine.

  Terry informed us, he will be unable to attend the meeting next month as he will be
  on vacation.

13. Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 11:00 AM. Motion approved. The next
  meeting will be Wednesday, June 20, 2018 at 10:00 AM.
